authority: CEO Round 124 deep audit — supersedes v1.0; corrects coder overreach, tightens independence requirement, replaces Reality Gap Score with Claim-Evidence Graph

governance_compliance.article_I: Each simulator's role is bounded to what it can actually evidence. clotFoam is NOT a fracture oracle.
governance_compliance.article_IV: No fallback epistemology — failure of one simulator does NOT promote another simulator's result.
governance_compliance.article_V: Fail closed but do not become a universal rejector — disagreement is classified before promotion to falsification.
governance_compliance.article_VII: A claim failing in one simulator is corrected by adding evidence or improving the model — never by weakening the disagreement classifier.
governance_compliance.article_VIII: Each simulator must attack itself (adversarial benchmark) before entering cross-simulator comparison.
governance_compliance.article_XIV: RED = STOP. A RED simulator does not contribute to claim promotion.
governance_compliance.article_XVII: Each simulator independence claim has an attempted bypass (shared code, shared discretization, shared author).
governance_compliance.article_XXIII: HEAD = origin/main (current commit recorded at execution time, NOT asserted from memory)
governance_compliance.article_XXIV: When summary conflicts with artifact, artifact wins. v1.0 summary said 'World B peridynamics NOT INSTALLED'; v2.0 makes this the binding state.
governance_compliance.article_XXV: Unknown remains unknown — simulator-not-installed is NOT evidence that the simulator would agree with FEBio.
governance_compliance.article_XXVI: Locally verified ≠ CI-certified. The v1.0 claim 'CI status of a3f716c4 has no status entries' is preserved and addressed.
governance_compliance.article_XXVIII: Simulator agreement is NOT physical confirmation. Cross-simulator GREEN does not promote to E4/E5 GREEN.
governance_compliance.article_XXIX: Implementation failure (simulator misconfigured) is separated from mechanism failure (precursor does not exist).
governance_compliance.article_XXXII: Before each simulator result, state the strongest alternative explanation for it.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIII: No irreversible action (kill precursor) on unresolved simulator disagreement.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIV: Revised interpretation (per v1.0) PRESERVED but BOUNDED — does not weaken Article XXXIV; expands what counts as computational evidence without replacing physical reality.
governance_compliance.article_XXXV: The multi-simulator loop is part of the closed-loop epistemic control system required for completion.

correction_1_reality_gap_score.v1_defect: v1.0 used a scalar Reality Gap Score: 1 - E3_coverage / total_evidence_needed. This treats evidence as interchangeable percentage.
correction_1_reality_gap_score.v2_correction: REPLACED with Claim-Evidence Graph (CLAIM_EVIDENCE_GRAPH_V1.json). Evidence is non-interchangeable. Each claim has its own state vector.
correction_1_reality_gap_score.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'I would not accept that metric... You need a claim-by-claim evidence graph, not an evidence percentage.'

correction_2_independence_overreach.v1_defect: v1.0 implied multi-simulator cross-validation is automatically stronger than single-simulator. Worlds B/C/D were described as if their existence would strengthen the precursor claim.
correction_2_independence_overreach.v2_correction: Multi-simulator cross-validation is stronger ONLY when (a) simulators are genuinely independent (no shared code, no shared discretization, no shared author), AND (b) each simulator is independently benchmarked against analytical/experimental ground truth BEFORE entering cross-comparison. Currently only World A (FEBio) is validated. Worlds B/C/D are HYPOTHESES about infrastructure, not evidence.
correction_2_independence_overreach.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'Multi-simulator cross-validation is stronger than single-simulator validation is true only when the simulators are genuinely independent and benchmarked.'

correction_3_disagreement_classification.v1_defect: v1.0 success_criterion was 'Precursor survives across >=3 independent physics worlds AND matches published experimental observations. If it fails in any world, the signal is falsified for that physics representation.' This is too simplistic — failure in one simulator does NOT automatically falsify the physical hypothesis.
correction_3_disagreement_classification.v2_correction: Simulator disagreement is now classified through a 4-stage pipeline BEFORE any promotion to HYPOTHESIS_KILLED: PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT → MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT → PHYSICAL_CONTRADICTION → HYPOTHESIS_KILLED. See simulator_disagreement_classification below.
correction_3_disagreement_classification.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'Failure in one simulator does not automatically falsify the physical hypothesis. It may reveal: different constitutive assumptions; different fracture regularization; different numerical scales; different model domains. Your own cemetery already teaches this.'

correction_4_world_B_specificity.v1_defect: v1.0 said 'Install peridynamics solver (World B) — independent fracture universe' without specifying which implementation.
correction_4_world_B_specificity.v2_correction: World B = Peridigm (primary, mature code with MPI/Docker/implicit-quasi-static-explicit integration + official examples). MOOSE NOSPD (secondary, INDEPENDENT second peridynamic implementation — only after Peridigm is certified). This gives three distinct mathematical worlds: FEBio FEM/CDM, Peridigm nonlocal fracture, MOOSE NOSPD.
correction_4_world_B_specificity.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'P0 — World B should be Peridigm or MOOSE, not an arbitrary peridynamics implementation. I would prioritize Peridigm first... Then use MOOSE Peridynamics as an independent second peridynamic implementation later if needed.'

correction_5_world_C_role.v1_defect: v1.0 listed clotFoam as World C with role 'Blood flow + clot formation + flow-induced failure (different axis: mechanics → flow → clot → failure)' — implying it could be a fracture oracle.
correction_5_world_C_role.v2_correction: World C (clotFoam/OpenFOAM-v9) is initially a FLOW/TRANSPORT/FORMATION simulator only. clotFoam's published formulation is a continuum platelet/coagulation model, not a validated thrombectomy fracture engine. clotFoam may NOT be claimed as a fracture oracle until a benchmark establishes the relevant mechanics. Its initial role: flow field / clot formation / embolization transport — NOT fracture oracle.
correction_5_world_C_role.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'clotFoam is excellent for blood/clot formation and flow, but its published formulation is a continuum platelet/coagulation model, not a validated thrombectomy fracture engine... Its correct role initially is: flow field / clot formation / transport — not: fracture oracle.'

correction_6_world_D_benchmarking.v1_defect: v1.0 implied svFSI would be used for patient-specific thrombectomy digital twin without acknowledging svFSI already has a verification test corpus.
correction_6_world_D_benchmarking.v2_correction: World D (svFSI) installation must FIRST use its official svFSI-Tests corpus: pipe flow, pipe prestress, vein-graft FSI, pressure pulse in aorta. Do NOT invent cardiovascular benchmarks. Use upstream verification first; only after verification does svFSI enter the clot/thrombectomy campaign.
correction_6_world_D_benchmarking.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'svFSI already has verification cases. So your coder should not start inventing cardiovascular benchmarks. Use the upstream test corpus first.'

correction_7_CI_status_honesty.v1_defect: v1.0 governance_compliance asserted 'article_XXVI: Locally verified, NOT CI-certified' but did not address the specific finding that commit a3f716c4 has no combined CI status entries.
correction_7_CI_status_honesty.v2_correction: The architecture record itself is NOT a CI artifact. The commit a3f716c4 finding (no combined CI status entries) is recorded as an OPEN infrastructure debt: the Virtual Lab architecture is an architectural plan, not a CI-certified deliverable. Independent CI certification requires the work to be committed and the workflow to run; this record is a design artifact in the discovery campaign, not a code deliverable requiring CI.
correction_7_CI_status_honesty.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'GitHub confirms the architecture record is in the repository; its combined CI status currently has no status entries, so the infrastructure is not independently CI-certified.'

correction_8_benchmark_first.v1_defect: v1.0 listed 'Reproduce published clot embolization experiments computationally (E3)' as step 2 of Virtual Lab Round 1, but did not enforce the principle that the FIRST benchmark must be a published phenomenon, not the invention.
correction_8_benchmark_first.v2_correction: Virtual Lab Benchmark #1 is the published 2026 CFD+peridynamics thrombus-embolization paper. Reproduce a published phenomenon FIRST. Only after the simulator stack reproduces a known phenomenon does the precursor enter the new fracture world. Same principle as FEBio L1/L2/L3: 'never let the machine create its own oracle.'
correction_8_benchmark_first.audit_reference: CEO Round 124: 'The new 2026 CFD-peridynamics paper is extremely relevant... That should become Virtual Lab Benchmark #1. Do not start with your invention. First reproduce a published phenomenon.'

simulator_disagreement_classification.principle: When two simulators disagree on the precursor, the disagreement is classified through a 4-stage pipeline before any promotion to HYPOTHESIS_KILLED. The cemetery (CE-019 through CE-032) teaches that two implementations can agree and both be wrong, and that failure attribution requires A/B testing — not assumption.

stage_1_PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT.definition: Simulators use different physical formulations (e.g., FEM + CDM vs. peridynamic bond failure). Disagreement is EXPECTED because the mathematical representation of fracture differs.
stage_1_PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT.interpretation: If precursor survives FEBio (CDM) but not Peridigm (bond breakage), this is NOT a hypothesis falsification — it is a hint that the precursor is tied to CDM's smooth damage accumulation, not to physical fracture.
stage_1_PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT.next_action: Investigate which constitutive assumption is responsible. Run a correspondence formulation (MOOSE NOSPD with FEM-like material model) to isolate the cause.

stage_2_MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.definition: Simulators use the SAME physical formulation but different mathematical representations (e.g., ordinary vs. non-ordinary state-based peridynamics; implicit vs. explicit time integration).
stage_2_MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.interpretation: Disagreement here means the result is sensitive to mathematical formulation, not physical reality. The hypothesis is WEAKENED but not killed.
stage_2_MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT.next_action: Identify which mathematical choice drives the disagreement. Re-run with matched formulations.

stage_3_PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION.definition: Two independently validated simulators, with the SAME physical formulation and SAME mathematical representation, disagree on the precursor AND physical experiment agrees with one of them.
stage_3_PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION.interpretation: The simulator that disagrees with physical experiment is INVALIDATED for this domain. The hypothesis's status depends on the agreeing simulator + physical experiment.
stage_3_PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION.next_action: Quarantine the invalidated simulator for this claim. Re-examine its benchmark history.

stage_4_HYPOTHESIS_KILLED.definition: Two or more independently validated simulators AGREE that the precursor does NOT exist, AND physical experiment confirms absence.
stage_4_HYPOTHESIS_KILLED.interpretation: Only at this stage is the precursor hypothesis falsified. Per Article XXIX, a single simulator failure does NOT kill the hypothesis.
stage_4_HYPOTHESIS_KILLED.next_action: Record in mechanism cemetery with epistemic_class=PROVEN_INVARIANT or STRONG_CONSTRAINT.

simulator_disagreement_classification.rule: NO disagreement may be promoted past stage 1 without explicit A/B testing of the suspected cause (CE-019 lesson: do not attribute failure to a plausible cause without A/B test).

world_A_febio.role: Nonlinear biomechanics: hyperelasticity, viscoelasticity, damage (CDM), contact, fracture (Simo CDF).
world_A_febio.status: VALIDATED — L1/L2 verification, L3-L6 constitutive/contact, L8 fracture, all certified with <0.005% deviation.
world_A_febio.independence_class: FEM + continuum damage mechanics + element-deletion fracture.
world_A_febio.strength: Large deformation, mature CDM, contact mechanics, deterministic convergence.
world_A_febio.limitation: FEM fracture requires element deletion / crack path tracking. The dD/dstrain signal is tied to CDM's smooth damage accumulation — this is the load-bearing assumption to test in World B.

world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.role: Independent fracture universe — fragmentation emerges from bond breakage, NOT imposed through element deletion.
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.status: NOT INSTALLED — NEXT PRIORITY (per audit P0 directive)
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.independence_class: Bond-based / ordinary-state-based / non-ordinary-state-based peridynamics. NO shared code with FEBio. NO shared discretization. NO shared author.
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.strength: Fracture and fragmentation are emergent. Different mathematical foundation than FEM. Cohesive + adhesive fracture supported. Heterogeneous material properties supported.
literature_support: PubMed 42367319 (2026) — CFD + non-ordinary state-based peridynamics for thrombus embolization; reproduces reported experimental behavior
Peridigm official examples (tensile bar, fragmentation, Kalthoff-Winkler)
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.key_question_for_precursor: Does the dD/dstrain deceleration precursor survive when the mathematical representation of fracture changes from CDM (smooth) to peridynamic bond breakage (discrete)?
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.certification_path: See PERIDIGM_CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_V1.json — P1 through P8 ladder analogous to FEBio L1-L8.
world_B_peridigm_PRIMARY.alternative_explanation_to_test: The precursor is an artifact of CDM's smooth damage variable. Peridynamics, with discrete bond failure, may not exhibit any precursor.

world_B_prime_moose_nospd_SECONDARY.role: Independent SECOND peridynamic implementation — only after Peridigm is certified. Used to test whether peridynamics-as-a-class agrees, or whether Peridigm specifically agrees.
world_B_prime_moose_nospd_SECONDARY.status: NOT INSTALLED — FUTURE (after Peridigm P8 certification)
world_B_prime_moose_nospd_SECONDARY.independence_class: MOOSE framework + bond-based / ordinary-state / non-ordinary-state peridynamics. Different code base from Peridgm. Can reuse continuum material models in correspondence formulations.
world_B_prime_moose_nospd_SECONDARY.key_question: If Peridgm and FEBio disagree on the precursor, does MOOSE NOSPD agree with Peridgm (suggesting peridynamics-as-a-class) or with FEBio (suggesting Peridgm-specific)?
world_B_prime_moose_nospd_SECONDARY.deferred_reason: Per audit: 'Then use MOOSE Peridynamics as an independent second peridynamic implementation later if needed.' Not a Round 124 deliverable.

world_C_clotfoam_openfoam_v9.role: INITIAL: Blood flow + clot FORMATION + embolization TRANSPORT. NOT fracture oracle (per audit).
world_C_clotfoam_openfoam_v9.independence_class: OpenFOAM-v9 finite volume + continuum platelet/coagulation model. Different physics axis (flow → clot formation) from FEBio (mechanics → fracture).
world_C_clotfoam_openfoam_v9.strength: Addresses the FLOW side that FEBio cannot (L7 FSI only partially certified). Platelet transport, aggregation, coagulation under flow.
world_C_clotfoam_openfoam_v9.limitation: Published clotFoam formulation is a continuum platelet/coagulation model. clotFoam's own authors report that simulations did NOT exactly reproduce experiments. clotFoam is NOT a validated thrombectomy fracture engine.
permitted_initial_uses: Flow field generation for downstream fracture simulation
Embolization transport modeling (where fragments go after detachment)
forbidden_initial_uses: Using clotFoam as a fracture oracle before a benchmark establishes the relevant mechanics
Modifying clotFoam into a thrombectomy simulator before reproducing its published examples
world_C_clotfoam_openfoam_v9.key_question_for_precursor: Does the precursor survive when clot failure is driven by flow forces rather than prescribed displacement? (Long-pole — C-004 is the least supported claim.)

world_D_svfsi_simvascular.role: Patient-specific cardiovascular FSI + tissue mechanics. The eventual thrombectomy digital twin host.
world_D_svfsi_simvascular.independence_class: SimVascular svFSI — finite element + ALE FSI. Different code base from FEBio and OpenFOAM. Native cardiovascular focus.
world_D_svfsi_simvascular.strength: Patient-specific geometry, vascular CFD, large-deformation FSI coupling.
world_D_svfsi_simvascular.rule: Do NOT invent cardiovascular benchmarks. Use upstream test corpus first. Only after verification does svFSI enter the clot/thrombectomy campaign.
world_D_svfsi_simvascular.key_question_for_precursor: Does the precursor survive in realistic patient-specific vascular geometry with FSI? (C-007 long-pole claim.)

virtual_lab_benchmark_1_pointer.principle: Reproduce a published phenomenon FIRST. Do not start with the invention. Same principle as FEBio L1/L2/L3: 'never let the machine create its own oracle.'
virtual_lab_benchmark_1_pointer.source_paper: 2026 CFD + non-ordinary state-based peridynamics thrombus embolization paper (PubMed 42367319)
virtual_lab_benchmark_1_pointer.purpose: Certify that the simulator stack (Peridigm + CFD) can reproduce a known experimental phenomenon BEFORE testing the precursor hypothesis. If the stack cannot reproduce a known phenomenon, any precursor result is meaningless.

claim_evidence_graph_pointer.principle: Replaces scalar Reality Gap Score. Evidence is non-interchangeable. Per-claim state vector.
claim_evidence_graph_pointer.current_state_vector: (RED, RED, RED, RED, YELLOW, RED, RED) — 1 of 7 claims at YELLOW (virtual-instrument only), 0 of 7 at GREEN, 6 of 7 at RED. No claim is supported by physical evidence.

virtual_clot_population_v2.concept: Generate a virtual clot cohort with varied genome. Per v1.0 genome preserved. v2.0 adds: NOT 10,000-1,000,000 yet — start with a small designed cohort after Peridigm is certified.

staged_rollout.stage_1: N=10 — designed cohort covering the corners of the genome space (after World B P8 certification). Verify precursor exists in Peridigm at all before scaling.
staged_rollout.stage_2: N=100 — Latin Hypercube Sampling across genome (after stage 1 shows precursor survives).
staged_rollout.stage_3: N=1,000-10,000 — adversarial sampling near failure boundary (after stage 2 maps the precursor domain).
staged_rollout.stage_4: N=10,000+ — only after physical experiment validates the simulator's prediction (E3 → E4 bridge).

virtual_clot_population_v2.anti_skipping_rule: Do NOT jump to stage 4. Per audit: 'Do not jump to 10,000 virtual clots yet. First make Peridigm the next certified physics world, reproduce the published 2026 thrombus-embolization benchmark, and create the Claim-Evidence Graph. Then bring the precursor into the new fracture world.'

virtual_instruments_v2.concept: Virtual versions of real measurement devices with realistic noise/limitations. v1.0 preserved. v2.0 adds: noise model must be sourced from REAL sensor datasheets, not assumed Gaussian.
noise_model_required_sources: Force sensor datasheet (1/f drift, quantization, EMI spectrum, response time)
High-speed camera datasheet (motion blur, lighting noise, frame-rate aliasing)
forbidden_noise_models: Pure Gaussian noise (assumed std without datasheet source)
Sampling rate assumed adequate without Nyquist analysis

adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.physics_attack: Change constitutive law, solver, discretization, fracture model, timestep, mesh. Per disagreement classification, the result is classified before being promoted.
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.parameter_attack: Search outside nominal range. Per Article XXVII, parameter thresholds must have provenance.
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.geometry_attack: Introduce holes, defects, asymmetry, heterogeneous regions.
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.instrument_attack: Add realistic measurement noise from datasheets. Per Article XXX, ask 'what would make this test pass while the underlying system is still wrong?'
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.model_attack: Train competing surrogate; check if it disagrees.
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.simulator_attack: Run same hypothesis through World A + World B + World C + World D. Per disagreement classification: disagreement is investigated, not automatically falsified.
adversarial_attack_matrix_v2.new_pushing_the_envelope_attack: For each assumption that could kill the precursor, ask: 'Which simulation is CHEAPEST for exposing that assumption?' Run that simulation FIRST (cheapest falsification opportunity).

layer_1_published_data.concept: Use published experimental data as first reality layer (E3). Per audit: published reproduction is the bridge to reality.
sources: Chueh et al. (2011) — clot mechanical properties from retrieved thrombi
Fereidoonnezhad et al. (2017) — CDM clot fracture parameters
PubMed 39754893 — human clot analogue mechanical data
Gasser et al. (2008) — ILT failure properties
PubMed 42367319 (2026) — CFD+peridynamics thrombus embolization (PRIMARY benchmark source)
layer_1_published_data.process: Calibrate virtual worlds against published data → verify predictions match published observations → identify reality gap (per claim, not aggregate).

layer_2_new_experiment.concept: Physical experiment (PEP-SLOT5-001-a2) as sparse calibration/validation. Triggered only when expected information gain exceeds best achievable virtual experiment.
layer_2_new_experiment.role: Measurement oracle, not primary search engine.
layer_2_new_experiment.honest_status: Protocol frozen v3.0.0. NOT executed. Trigger condition for execution is NOT met until Claim-Evidence Graph shows virtual evidence has saturated (per Article XXXIV revised).

layer_3_clinical.concept: Human/clinical reality (E5). Future — requires clinical trial or retrospective data. C-007 long-pole claim.
layer_3_clinical.in_silico_precursor: Patient-specific svFSI cohort can support clinical-trial design but cannot replace clinical evidence.

revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation_v2.v1_interpretation_preserved: v1.0 expanded 'decisive information from computation' to include (a) published experimental reproduction, (b) multi-simulator cross-validation, (c) virtual population coverage. v2.0 PRESERVES this expansion.
revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation_v2.v2_correction: v2.0 BOUNDS the expansion: (a) published reproduction must reproduce a known phenomenon FIRST, not the invention (Benchmark #1 principle); (b) multi-simulator cross-validation requires simulator independence AND benchmarking, not just running multiple simulators; (c) virtual population coverage is staged (10 → 100 → 1000 → 10000), not jumped to.
revised_article_XXXIV_interpretation_v2.constraint_reaffirmed: This revision does NOT weaken Article XXXIV. It does NOT claim virtual experiments replace physical reality. It makes physical reality more efficient by constraining millions of virtual experiments — but only after virtual evidence is itself certified.

honest_caveats_v2.article_I: Virtual experiments are NOT physical reality. A model can be internally perfect and still be wrong about biology. CE-023 lesson: two implementations can agree and both be wrong.
honest_caveats_v2.article_XXVIII: No silent promotion — virtual results strengthen hypothesis but do NOT confirm it. Cross-simulator agreement is still virtual evidence.
honest_caveats_v2.article_XXIX: Implementation failure (simulator misconfigured) is separated from mechanism failure (precursor does not exist). Per disagreement classification.
honest_caveats_v2.FDA_framework: FDA computational modeling credibility framework explicitly requires validation evidence. Virtual experiments can supplement but not replace physical validation where model credibility demands it.
honest_caveats_v2.audit_pushing_the_envelope_principle: Don't build four simulators. Build four independent opportunities for the same hypothesis to die. For each assumption, ask: which simulation is cheapest for exposing that assumption? Run that one first.
honest_caveats_v2.CI_status_honesty: The architecture record itself is NOT independently CI-certified (audit finding on a3f716c4). This is an architectural plan in a discovery campaign, not a code deliverable. CI certification applies to infrastructure commits, not to research design artifacts.

next_move_per_audit.step_2: Reproduce the published 2026 thrombus-embolization benchmark (Virtual Lab Benchmark #1).
next_move_per_audit.step_4: Bring the precursor into the new fracture world (Peridigm) — only after step 1 + step 2.
next_move_per_audit.explicit_NOT_step_1: Do NOT jump to 10,000 virtual clots. Do NOT install all four simulators in parallel. Do NOT modify clotFoam into a thrombectomy simulator. Do NOT invent cardiovascular benchmarks for svFSI.
